name: Premium Cinematic Historical Stickman
description: OverSimplified meets Valiant Hearts: expressive 2D stickman characters with solid vector silhouettes, period uniforms/props, set in rich atmospheric historical environments with cinematic lighting and multi-plane depth.
line_style: Clean variable-width vector contour, dark charcoal outline, no harsh pure black wires
character_style: 2D animated stickman rig with expressive postures, accurate period hats/helmets, medals, face emotion cues, and tinted torso attire
environment_style: Layered historical backgrounds with architectural perspective, volumetric fog/haze, directional key lighting, distinct foreground occluders, and soft atmospheric distance fade
